Comfortable spacing
css: .density-module{max-width:360px}.density-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}.density-actions button{padding:7px 10px;cursor:pointer}.density-module ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;border:1px solid #bbb;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}.density-module li{border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;transition:padding .15s ease}.density-module li:last-child{border-bottom:0}.density-module.compact li{padding:3px 9px;line-height:1.15}.density-module.comfortable li{padding:12px 14px;line-height:1.45}.density-module [data-status]{margin:8px 0 0;color:#555;font:13px system-ui}
